The '''Rebel Starfighter Corps. officer's uniform''' was the standard-issue dress uniform for the starfighter pilots within the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. The uniform generally varied in design, although they were generally green in color and possessed [[Rebel command insignia/Legends|shoulder rank plates]] on the left shoulder that indicated the Starfighter Corps. member's rank.

==Description==
*Green four-button double-breasted dress tunic.
*Gold belt with gold buckle.
*[[Rebel command insignia/Legends|Shoulder rank plate]] on the left shoulder
*[[Cape/Legends|Cape]]/[[Cloak/Legends|cloak]] (optional)
*[[Flight Badge]]s (optional)
*[[Battle Patch]]es (optional)
*[[Ribbon/Legends|Ribbon]] (optional)
*[[Medal (disambiguation)|Medals]] (optional)
